intent: Three original collectible Workshop worlds: Ukrainian-inspired craft, imagined 1994 nostalgia, and a fictional coordination city. Static artwork stays independent from gameplay and animated overlays.

assets.title: Garden of Threads
assets.prompt:
Create one original full-bleed 4:3 collectible background for a modern pixel-art territory-capture game. Prefer 1536×1152 output; actual file dimensions will be checked. Coherent visible pixel clusters, crisp silhouettes, selective dithering, restrained but luminous colors and a memorable central subject that remains readable at a 320-pixel-wide board. Design foreground, middle distance and background with rewarding small discoveries and quieter passages so a bright live cut stays readable during partial reveal. No UI, text, logos, score numbers, game markers, arrows, frame, collage, active player character or enemies. No screenshots, copied compositions or recognizable commercial game characters. Painted illumination may be rich; do not fake animation frames or promise interactive objects. Produce a finished single picture, not a concept sheet.
Scene: An original imagined Ukrainian craft courtyard at golden morning: a flowering pear tree, white plaster walls, warm wooden workshop doors, ceramic vessels and a small cloth in the foreground. Restrained floral-and-bird ornamental painting on everyday objects takes inspiration from Petrykivka's relationship with local nature. Emerald leaves, vermilion berries, cream walls and amber light; the open garden is the focal subject. Avoid treating unrelated regional traditions as one historically exact scene.

review.source: Sunlit craft courtyard, flowering tree, painted ceramics and walls, quiet open gate and distant river. Distinct large foreground vessels; no active player, hazards or interface painted into the scene. Ukrainian-inspired imagined place; no claim of regional or historical authenticity.
